of.needed: whether NodePool objects are still persisted in etcd at v1beta1 (CRD status.storedVersions still lists v1beta1)

consequence.statement: Existing NodePool objects remain stored as v1beta1 until rewritten; a storage version migration (re-write all objects) and an update of status.storedVersions must be run before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all NodePool objects so they are stored as v1, then remove v1beta1 from the nodepools.karpenter.sh CRD status.storedVersions.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the nodepools.karpenter.sh CRD changes from v1beta1 to v1, so existing NodePool objects stay stored as v1beta1 until a storage version migration rewrites them and status.storedVersions is updated, before a later release removes v1beta1.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for migration migration-required
